mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 150k signals stronger corporate earnings momentum, which lifts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when 3-month payroll acceleration exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-quarter contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, which depresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 2-quarter real consumption contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and cost margins, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 6.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer and construction demand, which depresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher earnings momentum, which lifts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO 3-month delta exceeds 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a 3-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which depresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
